definitions.gloss: pupil; disciple; student (of a master or school)
definitions.explanation: A person who studies under a particular master or teacher, or the group of such students collectively. Used in traditional arts, martial arts, academic lineages, and similar contexts where there is a clear master-student relationship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{師匠|ししょう}→師匠：12421_shishou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{門下|もんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: Become a disciple of a famous master.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{流派|りゅうは}→流派：13365_ryuuha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{門下|もんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名人|めいじん}→名人：03753_meijin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: This school has many accomplished practitioners among its disciples.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先生|せんせい}→先生：00609_sensei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{門下|もんか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}み→積む：02294_tsumu⟧、ようやく{免許皆伝|めんきょかいでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{得|え}た→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: After many years of training as a disciple of the teacher, I finally received full certification.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{門|もん}→門：14603_mon⟧ (gate) and {下|か} (under). Literally "under the gate," evoking the image of students gathered at the entrance to a master's school. The word carries a sense of formal apprenticeship and lineage. It is commonly used in traditional Japanese arts such as ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧ (tea ceremony), ⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧ (flower arrangement), ⟦{書道|しょどう}→書道：04178_shodou⟧ (calligraphy), martial arts, and ⟦{落語|らくご}→落語：04457_rakugo⟧ (comic storytelling).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {門下|もんか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}る→入る：00494_hairu⟧: to become a disciple
- {門下|もんか}{生|せい}: pupil, student (of a master)
- {門下|もんか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{育|そだ}てる→育てる：01235_sodateru⟧: to train disciples

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{弟子|でし}→弟子：03986_deshi⟧: disciple, apprentice — more general and commonly used in everyday conversation
- {門弟|もんてい}: pupil, disciple — a close synonym, slightly more literary
- ⟦{門人|もんじん}→門人：24440_monjin⟧: follower, student — similar nuance but slightly more formal
- {塾生|じゅくせい}: student at a private school or academy — refers to students at a specific institution rather than under a personal master
